business_problem: BioIVT had to prepare more than 25,000 complex research quotes a year while balancing quote creation with regulatory documentation, shipment tracking, and customer support.
solution_summary: BioIVT started its agentic AI rollout in quoting, where service teams already process more than 25,000 complex requests each year for research specimens with specific disease states, donor counts, and shipping constraints. The company built Ivy on Agentforce as a task-oriented quoting agent that reads each opportunity, interprets the requested products and fulfillment requirements, and compares them against more than 15,000 product codes held in a Data 360 catalog. For standard catalog quotes, a case is assigned to Ivy, a short pause allows human intervention if needed, and then the agent selects the right items, adds them to the opportunity, creates the quote, and routes it to customer service for a final check. Because the agent works from a unified catalog and existing Salesforce opportunity context, BioIVT moved quoting from days to minutes and freed reps to spend far more time on exceptions and high-value customer work.
